content.rendered:
?

?No matter how clean a palace is, you will always find the spider’s web.?
?
(Scientists say, if you left a spider’s?web long enough, bullets will not be able to penetrate.)
?
The reason we don’t see the spider’s silk?.?
in its full potential is because it is always “wiped out.”

However, the more it is wiped out, the more the spider spins new silk. Wipe it out again and you will see it again

Clean your house? a million times over, you will see the silk again and again?.?

?What you cleaned was just the “surface.”. The source is from the inside of the spider…its from within..

?You are bringing another “thing” out.?

Stop whining ?when they steal your ideas or project…there’s more where that came from✔

If they stole your business idea?
Dream again??
?
When they forcefully took Isaac’s well, he just moved on and dug another one.
They could not keep the previous one running because the grace to sustain it had moved with Isaac.
?
Genesis 26:15,18,22 KJV
For all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth. [18] And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them. [22] And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the Lord hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

✔The Lord is about to make room for you and that time is now.
✔The Lord will settle & establish you in all endeavors.
✔For all you have lost, the Lord will give you multiple times over in Jesus name
